title: Space owner guides match the product, and Create a Space, Spotlight, themes, email preferences, getting help, the app map and free courses each have a guide

source.ref: Help center audit and rework 2026-11-18 (project thread: Rework every help doc and help search)

detail:
Owner ask 2026-11-18: read every help doc against the code, fix what is stale, add what is missing. The audit of content/help/spaces found, among others: your-website.md said there are two themes, Default and Bold (ten are offered, lib/theme/site-style.ts); billing.md said any admin can change billing (owner only, settings/billing/actions.ts) and named a portal button that does not exist; five articles gave a menu path to Plan and billing that does not exist (it is Manage, Profile & Settings, Plan and billing); plan-your-calendar.md listed five views that are not the seven in lib/calendar/planner/suite-model.ts; take-bookings.md described deposits as live and free bookings as unlimited; community-resonance.md said custom CRM stages come later (Edit stages exists). Seven features had no guide at all: Create a Space, Spotlight, picking a theme, email preferences (/manage-emails), getting help (Vera, reports), the app map after the left rail rework, and free courses (/courses).

DONE 2026-11-18: all 17 Space guides rewritten against the code with one format and search keywords; seven new guides written; four feature keys added (create-space, spotlight, themes, support) so the drift signal covers them. Left out on purpose because they are switched off or not on main: Google Calendar sync, Market filters, Hunts teams, course certificates, /build partner pages.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
